snippet.title: Sanctuary: Shattered Sun | First Multiplayer Q&A + EDA Tier 4 Reveal (pre-alpha gameplay)
snippet.description:
This is footage from our first multiplayer session for Sanctuary: Shattered Sun. February 2026, pre-alpha build. This was exclusive to our Patreon members as a thank you for their continued support.

We had developers playing across three continents - Australia, the US, and Europe - testing cross-continental multiplayer while answering community questions live. This session includes the first public reveal of the EDA Tier 4 railgun sniper experimental unit.

The session covers faction design philosophy, intel and reconnaissance systems, multiplayer technical infrastructure, post-launch plans including the Warfront mode concept, our Kickstarter timeline, anti-cheat approach, and the challenges of making realistic military hardware look as visually impressive as plasma weapons and solar-themed explosions.

This is pre-alpha footage. The game is still in active development. 

00:00 - Session Start & First Game Setup
02:47 - First Multiplayer Game Begins
05:18 - Unit Balance & UI Questions
11:02 - Intel Systems Discussion (Stealth, Jamming, Cloaking)
18:16 - Map Features (Reclaim, Civilians, Neutral Teams)
22:13 - Second Game Begins (2v2 White Desert)
26:10 - Unit Capture & Additional Controls
30:19 - Faction Playstyle Philosophy (Chosen, Guard, EDA)
42:48 - EDA Design Philosophy & Development Progress
48:00 - Multiplayer Release Timeline Discussion
52:02 - Future Game Concepts (Tactical RTS Ideas)
1:05:13 - EDA TIER 4 REVEAL (Railgun Sniper)
1:08:31 - Line Drag & Front System Explanation
1:13:25 - Faction Visual Themes & Art Direction
1:17:39 - Multiplayer Technical Systems (Reconnection, Replays)
1:25:20 - DLC Discussion (Why No Alien Factions)
1:31:20 - Warfront Mode Concept (Meta-Game DLC)
1:37:36 - Anti-Cheat Approach & Spectating Systems
1:51:32 - Kickstarter Readiness & Patreon Rewards
1:55:42 - Final Thoughts & Session Wrap-Up
